dialogue.Introduction: Ah, a visitor! I am the Wizard, keeper of this tower and of all the mana hiding in these woods. You may call me Master if you bring me interesting things.$h
dialogue.Mon: Good morning, @. The mana is thick today, like honey left out in the sun. Mind the sparkles, they bite.$h
dialogue.Tue: Tuesday. Mercury is in retrograde, which means my spells go backward and my socks come off. Nothing to be alarmed about.$u
dialogue.Wed: The Merchant sold me a mana potion that tasted like cold soup. I think he waters his stock. A wizard knows these things.$a
dialogue.Thu: I was up all night reading the old texts. Half the words are smudged, and the other half are rude to me.$s
dialogue.Fri: Fridays are for experiments. Last week I turned my hat into a frog. This week I will try to turn the frog back into a hat.$h
dialogue.Sat: Saturday, and the saloon is loud. I prefer my own quiet company, a candle, and a nice chilled potion.$h
dialogue.Sun: Sunday is for contemplation. I spent the whole morning staring at a cloud. It looked exactly like an eye, which is most unsettling.$u
dialogue.Mon2: Oh, @, you again? Stay a while. The tower chairs are very comfortable once you stop them from bouncing.$h
dialogue.Wed2: Careful on the staircase. The third step is a teleporter, and it sends you straight to the Dryad's garden. She does not like visitors who drop in uninvited.$u
dialogue.Fri2: I have been meaning to ask. Do you have any spare bottles? Empty ones, mind you. I keep catching ghosts in them and then wondering where they went.$s
dialogue.Thu2: Thursday tends to be a cloudy day for mana. If you see a strange glow over the forest, that is probably me, trying a new light spell.$h
dialogue.Sat2: The Stylist asked me to cast a glamour on her hair. I did it, and now it sparkles at night. She says it is perfect. I say it is a fire hazard.$h
dialogue.Mon4: @, you have been stopping by so often that my tower is starting to feel like home. Do not get used to me being this cheerful.$h
dialogue.Tue4: I have been brewing a potion to make people taller. It was meant for the Angler, not for you. Somehow we both ended up with a little extra height.$h
dialogue.Wed4: You know what makes the forest feel alive? Friends who visit. Even the squirrels have started to wave at me.$h
dialogue.Thu4: I finished a small charm for you. Do not thank me yet. It only works if you remember to wear it on Fridays.$h
dialogue.Fri4: The Angler keeps asking whether I can make the fish grow legs. I told him that is not a question for a wizard. It is a question for a fisherman.$u
dialogue.Sat4: Some nights I stare at the stars and wonder what the future holds. Then I look at my friends and think, perhaps the future is already here.$h
dialogue.Sun4: A quiet Sunday with good company. This is the kind of magic I like best, @. The kind you do not need a spellbook for.$h
dialogue.Mon6: A little secret, @. The mana flows strongest right here, which is why I built the tower in this forest. The trees whisper to me, and I whisper back.$h
dialogue.Mon8: I never tell anyone this, but when I was a boy I wanted to be a knight. The magic found me instead. I am glad it did, because now I have you.$s
dialogue.Tue8: Sometimes the mana goes quiet, and the tower falls silent. In those moments I think about how lonely I used to be. Thank you for filling that silence.$l
dialogue.Wed8: I wrote a letter to my old master once. He never wrote back. I still keep his staff by the door, in case he ever comes to visit.$s
dialogue.Thu8: @, I trust you more than my spellbooks. The books lie about the ingredients, but you always tell me the truth about my hat.$h
dialogue.Fri8: If the tower ever burned, I would save the books first, and then you. Please do not ask me to explain the order.$l
dialogue.Sat8: The saloon has a piano, and the Tavernkeep says I may play it. I think I will, one night, and you will be my first audience.$h
dialogue.Sun8: You have made this old wizard feel young again. I used to stare at empty shelves. Now I stare at a friend who brings cake.$l
dialogue.Mon10: @, I have started leaving the tower door open at night, just in case you need a place to rest when the monsters get too loud.$l
dialogue.Wed10: Do you know what the stars whisper when the moon is full? They say you are a good friend. I agree with them, though they also said I should cook more.$l
dialogue.Fri10: I have read every book in this tower, yet my favorite story is still the one you tell me when we sit by the fire together.$l
dialogue.Sat10: If the valley ever falls into darkness, I will light every candle in the tower and wait for you. That is a promise from a wizard, and we never break those.$l
dialogue.spring_Wed: Spring mornings in the forest smell like rain and new magic. The flowers hum louder, and so do my pet slimes.$h
dialogue.summer_Fri: The summer heat makes my tower stuffy, so I enchanted a fan to blow cool mana breezes. It mostly blows my papers into the river.$a
dialogue.fall_Sun: Autumn leaves fall in patterns that look like runes. I spent an entire afternoon trying to read them. I am fairly sure they said remember the Wizard.$h
dialogue.winter_Tue: Winter in the valley is bitterly cold, but the tower stays warm with a crackling fire and a dozen spellbooks for kindling. Do not tell the librarian.$u
dialogue.winter_Fri8: I have been dreaming of a spell that makes snowflakes fall upward. Silly, I know. But tonight, @, I think you would enjoy seeing it with me.$l
dialogue.fall_15: Halfway through autumn and the tower is busier than ever. A wizard's work is never done, but good company makes it lighter.$h
dialogue.spring_5: Early spring is the best time to plant new magic herbs. I have a whole row of mana flowers. Please do not step on them, they scream.$a
dialogue.summer_20: A warm summer evening, perfect for catching fireflies for my lanterns. If you have a spare moment, a few more would be wonderful.$h

rainy: Rain on the tower means my lightning rods sing all afternoon. Stay inside, @, and let the thunder keep us company for a while.$h

situations.eye: The Eye of Cthulhu is gone, and I have never been so glad to see an eyeball vanish. It stared at my tower for weeks. Very rude.$h
situations.evilBoss: The Eater of Worlds and the Brain of Cthulhu have finally been defeated. Those worms and brains make dreadful tea guests. The tower is safe again.$h
situations.skeletron: Skeletron has fallen and the dungeon is open. The Old Man was freed, and now he floats around my tower asking for directions.$u
situations.queenBee: The Queen Bee is dead. The honey smelled wonderful, but I sneezed for three days. Never let a bee near me again.$s
situations.hardmode: The Wall of Flesh has fallen and hardmode has begun. The Hallow is spreading and the mana crystals glow brighter than ever. Stay close, @.$u
situations.mechs: One of the mechanical bosses has been destroyed. The clanking has stopped, and the tower no longer shakes every time someone sneezes.$h
situations.plantera: Plantera has been defeated. The jungle temple is open now, and the vines have finally stopped whispering my name at night.$h
situations.golem: The Golem is no more. Its stone head rolled right past my tower. I have kept its eye as a paperweight, though it is very distracting.$u
situations.cultist: The Lunatic Cultist has fallen. The celestial pillars are glowing, and I can feel the mana pour through the sky like a river.$u
situations.moonLord: The Moon Lord has been defeated. The sky is quiet again and the stars are singing softly. I think they are relieved too.$h
situations.goblins: The goblin army has been repelled. Their war drums are silent, and I finally finished my tea without a spear flying past the window.$h
situations.pirates: The pirates have been driven off. The Pirate is shouting about his ship, and I am shouting about the mess they left in my garden.$a
situations.frostLegion: The Frost Legion is beaten. My tower frosted over, and I had to thaw my spellbooks by the fire. Slightly singed, but alive.$s
situations.martians: The Martian Madness is over. Their saucers zipped over the forest all night, and I think one of them tried to borrow my telescope.$u
situations.bloodMoon: There was a blood moon last night. The shadows crawled out of the forest, and I spent the whole night reading protection charms.$s
situations.eclipse: The sun went dark during yesterday's eclipse. I spent the afternoon stargazing and hoping the valley would come back. It did, thank goodness.$u
situations.party: The Party Girl is throwing a party today. I have been asked to bring the fireworks. Mana fireworks, which are safer than they sound, I hope.$h

festivals.spring13: The Egg Festival! I hid a glowing crystal egg somewhere in the fields. Find it and I will teach you a spell. It is not a real egg, so do not eat it.$h
festivals.spring24: The Flower Dance is tonight. I spent all week levitating petals onto the dance floor. Try not to sneeze, the pollen is extremely magical.$h
festivals.summer11: The Luau! I put a jar of mana essence into the community soup. It should make everything taste delicious, and possibly glow.$h
festivals.summer28: The Dance of the Moonlight Jellies. I have spent the evening on the beach with my lanterns, and the jellies float up and light the water. It is wonderful.$l
festivals.fall16: The Stardew Valley Fair. I entered the spell contest, though the judges mostly wanted to see me make a cat float. It was a fair result.$h
festivals.fall27: Spirit's Eve! The haunted maze is full of ghosts, and several of them insist they are my former students. Do not believe a word they say.$u
festivals.winter8: The Festival of Ice. I carved a snow dragon and cast a warming spell on it. Mostly. The dragon is now sitting in a puddle, looking very pleased.$h
festivals.winter25: The Feast of the Winter Star. I wrapped my gift with a tiny enchantment. It is supposed to open itself when the right person holds it.$h

loved.text: Oh! Oh, @, this is exactly what my tower was missing. I could cry. Actually, I am crying a little, it is the magic.$l

liked.text: A lovely trinket. It will look marvelous on my desk, between the candles and the cursed lamp.$h

neutral.text: Hm. Thank you, I suppose. Every object has a secret purpose, and I will find this one's eventually.$h

disliked.text: Ugh, this smells like a slime's bad dream. Please take it away before the candles sneeze.$a

hated.text: How dare you bring this into my tower! Get it out, get it out before it summons a goblin!$a

help: Bit of help here? My spell is fizzling!
Someone hit that thing before it hexes me!
A little help, please. The mana is flaring!
thanks: Oh, @, you saved my beard from a very bad fireball. Thank you.$h
That was far too close. You are now a permanent resident of my favourite thoughts.$l
battle: Prepare to be thoroughly incinerated, beast!
Mana bolt! Hold still, you oversized toad!
By my beard, this tower will not fall tonight!
courage.hurt: Ow. My hat is scorched and my dignity is in a ditch. I shall rest and consult the stars about this.$s

danger.boss: A boss is stalking the woods, @. Good. I have been waiting for a worthy spell to test.$h
danger.invasion: Goblins, pirates, whatever they are, they will meet my lightning rods. Stand with me.$h
danger.pumpkinMoon: The pumpkin moon rises and the scarecrows are restless. I have a hex for that.$h
danger.frostMoon: The frost moon brings legions of ice, and my fingers are freezing. Bring a coat and a spell.$s
danger.eclipse: The sun has gone dark and strange shapes crawl from the shadows. I shall light the way.$h
danger.bloodMoon: A blood moon! The mana tastes of iron tonight. Keep your sword sharp and stay near the tower.$a

events.after: Careful with that crystal, it is still deciding whether it likes you.

steps.say: Ah, @! Do not touch the crystal, it is still deciding whether it likes you.$u

Hm. Mana has not flowed properly through this tower since the goblins moved in next door. Everything hums, the teapot sings, and my beard floats.#$b#I am told this is normal for a wizard. I am told a great many things.$h

answers.reply: Excellent! Then you may hold my hat while I work.$h
Tricks? Hah! Tell that to the moon when it turns red.$a

steps.say: Here, a small gift. Carry it wisely, it bites when it is bored.$h

events.after: The stars are loud tonight. Listen to them with me, if you like.

steps.say: @, you climbed my tower stairs at night. Brave, or foolish. I am still deciding which.$s

Sit, sit. The stars are louder tonight. I can hear them humming their old songs.#$b#When I was young, I wanted to be the greatest wizard in all of Terraria. Then I spent a whole afternoon trying to turn a slime into a sheep.$s

answers.text: Did you ever get a sheep?
answers.reply: No sheep. Only a very confused slime that followed me around for a week.$h

answers.text: That sounds like a waste of time.
answers.reply: Waste? Every failure is a lesson written in mana.$a

steps.say: The real magic, @, is finding someone who will listen when the stars get loud.$l
Now hush. The constellation of the old staff is about to appear.$h

events.after: The Guide still owes me a bookshelf. Tell him that for me.

steps.say: Ah, @! Good timing. Our friend the Guide has been asking me to fix his bookshelf. It keeps dropping all its books on his head.$h
I told him the books are not cursed. They are simply unhappy about being read incorrectly.$u
Oh, so now I am cursed, am I?
Only a little. Do not panic, it is a very small curse.$h

steps.question: Should we help him with the books?

answers.reply: Splendid! A wizard and a farmer together are stronger than any spell.$h
The Guide will not like that, but I admire your honesty.$h

steps.say: Hey, I am right here, you know.
Anyway. Thank you, @, for stopping by. Next time bring cake, the Guide never shares.$h

events.after: Thank you for listening to this old wizard. It means more than I can say.

steps.say: @, I was hoping you would visit. Sit by the window. The valley looks like a painting from up here.$s
I used to think I was the only one who could see the mana flowing through the hills. Then the Dryad looked at me like I was a silly child.#$b#She was right. Maybe I still am, a little bit.$h
Some nights the sky goes red and I remember the fear. The Blood Moon once took half my library. I still feel the empty shelves when I walk past them.$s

steps.question: Would you like to hear a spell I never finished?

answers.reply: It is a spell for remembering. I have never got past the first word.$l
Of course. The words will keep, like a good cup of tea.$h

steps.say: Thank you for listening, @. You make this old tower feel less lonely.$l

events.after: I meant what I said, apprentice. Come by the tower whenever you like.

steps.say: @! Perfect timing. The Pirate and I were arguing about whether the ocean has mana or just salt.$h
Salt, obviously.$a
Mana is in the water, you fool. Look at the waves, they glow whenever I cast.$h
@, I have been thinking. You have helped me more than any apprentice could. I would like to offer you something.#$b#Every wizard needs a true student. Would you be mine?$l

answers.reply: Then wear this, my apprentice. It is a small thing, but it hums like a promise.$l
Take your time. Good apprentices are worth waiting for.$h

steps.say: Oh, and do not tell the Pirate. He will want a discount.$h
I heard that!$a
